script.voice: Round one, *price.* {three hundred thousand|$300K} versus {three twenty five.|$325K.} The house is *cheaper.*
Round two, *rent.* {twenty one hundred|$2,100} versus {twenty seven fifty.|$2,750.} Two units beat *one.*
Round three, *monthly* *costs.* Mortgage, taxes, insurance, upkeep. The house costs *less* to run.
Round four, *cash* *flow.* The house *loses* {two seventy five|$275} a month. The duplex stays *positive.*
{cash on cash|*Cash-on-cash*} return. The duplex takes it, {three to two.|3–2.}
And if you *live* in one unit,
the other unit's rent covers *most* of your *mortgage.*
{Deal Caddie|*DealCaddie*} runs both, side by side, in *seconds.*
